optics.tubeLensCertainty: educational_schematic reference from O, proprietary prescription unknown
optics.condenserNote: NA>=1 requires immersion per M printed29; G1 is dry. No oil-immersion objective is fitted.
optics.resolutionFormula: 0.61*wavelength/NA is representative Rayleigh scale, not clinical resolution prediction.
optics.imageModel: Depth-aware synthetic 3D cells and nuclei. Each entity has XYZ/radii; focal-depth difference modifies its point-spread footprint and peak. Not a blur of one flat image.
optics.rayModel: Paraxial thin-lens transfer for a selected synthetic object point; at focal plane objective output bundle is parallel, away from focus converges/diverges. Tube lens forms displaced intermediate plane; eyepiece and eye shown separately. Non-metric horizontal display scaling, physical ray arithmetic uses mm.
optics.irisModel: Qualitative brightfield: closing aperture lowers effective lateral NA and increases axial depth response; magnification unchanged. effectiveNA=objectiveNA*sqrt(aperture), clipped min0.1 for numerical stability. This interpolation is educational, uncalibrated, not a manufacturer optical transfer function.

illuminationModel.basis: field stop and condenser define specimen-plane illumination independently from objective selection; numerical slider calibration is illustrative, not manufacturer dimensions
illuminationModel.calibrationNote: Educational mapping only: 3000 um maximum radius chosen to cover the configured 4X FN22 field (2750 um radius) including initial centering offset. Not manufacturer diaphragm calibration.

turret.geometryCertainty: reasonable_estimate from exterior. Six positions/manual action confirmed; tilt and radial geometry are not manufacturer CAD.
turret.exchangeTargetCertainty: reasonable_estimate derived clearance for rough model, not IFU numeric rule
turret.slotAssignmentCertainty: photo-directed visual estimate: selected20, adjacent4 then10; visible green/red/yellow order better matches user photo1, exact slot numbering and actual lens identifiers not readable. Same documented 4 objectives retained; not an asserted manufacturer default.

stage.originCertainty: reasonable_estimate: total travels/gains confirmed; absolute Z and central origin chosen for teaching assembly
stage.carriage: Simplified visible specimen carrier. Internal wires/gears are not asserted.
stage.prefocusRule: Coarse only upper stop. Fine motion is NOT restricted by pre-focusing lever: M printed21/PDF27. Mechanical absolute travel remains.
stage.xyKnobAngleCertainty: visual rotation per displacement is illustrative; manufacturer mm/turn for XY not available in verified sources

xyKnobAssignment.basis: AX8962-10 PDF30 / printed24; diagram and text
xyKnobAssignment.directions: X right/left; Y front/back confirmed. UI up-drag->positive displacement and angular sign/gain remain teaching mapping, not verified real turning sense.

mechanics.contactPolicy: GLB-derived convex-piece educational swept prediction for mounted objectives versus holder, fixings and loaded slides; never manufacturer electronic interlock. Concave holder footprints decomposed. Full service-path/browser acceptance remains pending.
mechanics.rack: Detached parts move to a labelled teaching rack, not a manufacturer accessory. Thread pitch/complex fastening is schematic.

tubeExterior.source: C PDF76, top and side unit drawing
tubeExterior.certainty: confirmed dimensions of U-TR30-2; detailed shell profile remains visual estimate

condenserMount.basis: M printed53/55/57 assembly drawings: stage/condenser holders on common stage carrier; qualitative exterior coupling from public assembly, no internal drive claimed
condenserMount.certainty: reasonable_estimate of full assembly coupling; detailed holder profile not manufacturer CAD
condenserMount.gapCertainty: visual exterior estimate, not a measured manufacturer working distance

holderPivot.opening: right jaw rotates outward about rear hinge, approx40 degrees
holderPivot.certainty: visual estimate from official U-HRDT-4 exterior image; no hidden linkage claimed

eyeErgonomics.geometry: Runtime reuses existing r36 stable IDs. IPD translation and eyecup fold are schematic; no manufacturer internal linkage asserted. Lower flange shape.3 remains fixed; barrel shape.2 rotates/translates with eyecup/eye surface. Translation uses thin lens approximation, not manufacturer thread pitch.
eyeErgonomics.diopterModel: Fixed25mm thin eyepiece, intermediate plane to ocular distance=1000/(40-D)mm. Same signed paraxial retinal spread supplies tissue blur, rescaled from15% representative rays to effective pupil, added to diffraction width. Positive ocular adjustment can compensate defocused intermediate image. Emmetropic unaccommodated eye with17mm focal length is schematic; real accommodation unmodeled.
eyeErgonomics.verification: 46 unit tests pass; new browser/pose/collision evidence pending, not G2 acceptance

mechanics.twoSlideLoading: M printed22/PDF28: rear first then front; remove front before rear. Rear insertion/removal blocked while front occupied, preserving front-to-back path.

demonstration.illumination: field radius and aperture cone separate; same specimen-point illumination predicate as image

defaultConditions: 対物交換はステージを十分に下げ、クランプを緩めてレボルバーを前へ抜き、対物を上向きに机へ置いて交換する(M38/39)。レボルバーの装着/締結後に観察。4mm下げは仮の粗モデルの移動余裕として採用した教材目標で、実機数値規定ではない。着脱動作中の二重開始拒否。
configurationExclusions: U-TR30-2は固定30度。別鏡筒の傾斜調整を混ぜない
U-AC2には別U-SC3の上玉swingoutを付けない
乾式対物のみ、LBA追加filterは現在構成なし
非コードU-D6REではLIM不可。LEDとmotorized/coded nosepiece併用時だけ利用可能(M17)。選択対物は教材HUDで示し、実機に電子検出を捏造しない。
serviceExclusions: 筐体内歯車/送り機構分解
レンズ処方/レンズ分解
learning: 倍率/視野/焦点/光路を同じ機械Stateから描く
装着を外すと当該穴または眼の観察は成立しない
焦点は同じ深さ付き標本内の焦点面を変える
XYを動かすと像が反転して移動
原理表示の切替は機械・標本を変更しない

acceptance.G1: 主要操作→姿勢→深さ付き像→光路と代表的不成立を実画面操作。保存復元、安定ID、Chrome/WebKitを検査してWAITING_G1停止
acceptance.G2: 全operationsのP0/P1、全教材/外観/受入試験。G1残項目をP2へ下げない

independentExpectations.missingObjective: 細胞像なし/結像光路は穴で中断
independentExpectations.missingLeftEyepiece: 左眼像なし/中間像は残る

limits: 同構成の公式全体寸法未確定。別組立275x383x482mmを強制適用しない
筐体/取付/着脱経路は視覚推定。ねじピッチや全嵌合未検証
内部光学は理想無限遠系の模式表示、メーカー処方ではない
合成細胞/PSF/照度は教育近似。診断精度や実測強度ではない
全P1/非分解保守/収差・コヒーレンス/全姿勢干渉/性能はG2へ残す
G1候補を機器完成合格数へ算入しない
